name: 18-table-from-above
prompt: Top-down shot of a round dinner table mid-conversation, hands, glasses, plates and candles, executives leaning in from all sides, faces not visible, warm low light with pink and gold reflections. Cinematic, luxury, high-end corporate film. Deep black and charcoal palette, with subtle hot pink (#FF1FA9) and warm gold-yellow (#FCD500) neon rim light and soft neon glow rings. Shallow depth of field, anamorphic lens flares, rich shadows, filmic grain. No on-screen text, no logos, no watermarks.
